name: Palette cycle on a held word

source.description: 3 inspected reference films (batch-2, batch-3, 2026-11-26): a word-card launch cycles one held word through four colour pairs, and a long kinetic-type reel recolours a repeated word every 0.1 s at the peak of a montage.

technique: One word holds its place while its background and type colours swap on hard cuts several times a second, so the word reads as one thing shown in many themes, or, faster, as mounting agitation.
purpose: Show one thing in many themes, or, faster, build agitation, without changing the word.
visual_behaviour: One word holds its place, size and font while its card's background and type colours swap on hard cuts several times a second.
mechanics: Word position, size and font fixed; on each cut swap the background and text colour pair: 4 pairs every 0.23-0.27 s (7-8 frames at 30 fps) in ref-b4e79aa0a4 6.24-6.98 s; every 0.1 s (3 frames) on repeated words at the end of a montage in ref-58ff9f39df 113.9-115.8 s. Contrast-safe pairs only.

parameters.name: swap_sec
parameters.range: 0.2-0.3 s; 0.1 s only with pairs of similar lightness (photosensitivity)

failure_modes: Changing the word at the same time makes it unreadable

Photosensitivity cap (WCAG 2.3.1, three-flashes rule; not measured on the reference): no more than 3 flashes, that is 6 opposing large luminance changes, in any 1 s over a large area. Alternating dark and light full-frame backgrounds every 0.1 s gives about 5 flashes a second; keep swaps at 0.2 s or longer when consecutive backgrounds differ strongly in lightness, or change hue at similar lightness.

implementation.approach: Hold one word element; on each cue set() (no tween) the background and text colour custom properties to the next contrast-safe pair from the style system. Studio.comp.wordBeats has no per-beat palette option yet.

limitations: Fast cycles over 3 flashes per second are excluded by the photosensitivity cap

provenance.observed: The word 'brand.' holds while its card cycles through four colour pairs every 0.23-0.27 s.
At the end of the montage the same word is recoloured every 0.1 s on black, cream, terracotta and blue.
Image variant: a two-word headline holds while 14 full-frame website backgrounds swap every 2-4 frames (0.07-0.13 s) for 1.5 s (16.67-18.13 s); then the counter takes over.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown).
